dialogues.speaker: Lila
dialogues.text: *sob* ...The doctor is a meanie, grandma! The shot she gave me hurt!

dialogues.speaker: Tahmina
dialogues.text: No, she's not a meanie but an agent for Greater Lord Rukkhadevata.

dialogues.speaker: Tahmina
dialogues.text: Lila is an unwell little tree, and she is nourishing you, little tree.

dialogues.speaker: Lila
dialogues.text: I know Rukkhadevata is good, so the doctor is good too?

dialogues.speaker: Tahmina
dialogues.text: Yes. Listen to her and you'll grow tall and strong.

dialogues.speaker: Tahmina
dialogues.text: Otherwise, the Eremites will take you away for defying Rukkhadevata!

dialogues.speaker: Lila
dialogues.text: No, the Eremites are scary, I don't want that...
